modInfo: this is a riverside villa I made, which is suitable for 2-8 players.
In order to save it, I made it into a module, which is a real sea view room, sunshine,sand,and blue water

.  There was a small garage and a big parking pad, and I didn't install a door to the garage for convenience. There is a very exquisite flower room, which may give you a touch of warmth in the cruel apocalypse.
I spent a lot of time designing its layout and decoration and hope you like it.
